items.desc: With defending champions Lumbini Lions leading the pack, six franchises remain in mathematical contention for playoff qualification.

items.title: Three in four transport jobs in Nepal are informal
items.desc: ILO study calls for stronger labour protections, affordable social security contributions, and a legal framework to protect ride-hailing and delivery workers.

items.title: Nepal launches TikTok campaign to promote tourism to global audiences
items.desc: The campaign, running until the end of 2026, aims to showcase Nepal’s natural beauty, cultural heritage and diverse tourism experiences through digital storytelling and international content creators.

items.title: Nepal’s game developers seek tax relief, Google access to scale globally
items.desc: Industry leaders say high taxes and restrictions on Google Play merchant accounts are stifling local developers, as the prime minister pledges to create conditions for a home-grown technology unicorn.

items.title: Nepal’s share market weathers political jitters
items.desc: Rumours of a possible arrest of a top politician, business figures in custody, and the Tihar festive season rattled investors, but technical indicators suggest the market is regaining some stability.

items.title: Nepal’s peak electricity demand hits 1,813MW on Laxmi Puja evening
items.desc: The country exported 587.3MW of surplus power to India, while electricity supply remained uninterrupted nationwide during peak hours.

items.title: Nepal expects peak electricity demand to reach 1,700MW on Laxmi Puja
items.desc: The Nepal Electricity Authority says domestic generation will be sufficient to meet demand during Tihar, with industries expected to remain closed and power exports continuing.

items.title: Nepal clinch U-19 women’s cricket title unbeaten in China
items.desc: The four-team Belt and Road Series saw Nepal win four of their six matches, with the remaining two abandoned due to rain.

items.title: Poland mourns victims of Krakow mass shooting as security fears grow
items.desc: The 24-year-old suspect’s parents and sister were ​later found dead at their home, and he remained in hospital in a critical condition.

items.title: How Nepali artists are celebrating Tihar
items.desc: From buying silverware and festive essentials to writing screenplays and mourning loved ones, Nepali artists have different ways of marking—or sitting out—Tihar.
